data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic element vidu, meaning 'to know'. This name represents power, strength, and knowledge. In Christian tradition, it can also symbolize the wisdom and power of God. The name Vidovic carries the meaning “Power, strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Vidovic usually hope their child will grow to embody power, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vidovic total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
data.cultural_impact: The Slavic name Vidovic comes from the Slavic element vidu, meaning 'to know'. Historically, Slavic cultures placed great value on wisdom and knowledge. This name would have been given to a child who was expected to be intelligent, thoughtful, and insightful. In contemporary society, the name Vidovic can still represent strong intellectual abilities and a deep appreciation for learning.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Vidovic can symbolize the wisdom and power of God. The name invokes the idea of divine knowledge and understanding, reminding the bearer of the importance of seeking God's guidance and wisdom in their lives. Additionally, the name can represent strength and resilience in the face of challenges, as those who trust in God's wisdom and knowledge are empowered to overcome adversity and lead fulfilling, purposeful lives.
